description: This file contains mock implementations of functions using the vitest testing framework, intended for use in unit testing. It exports mock functions and wrapper functions for mocking behaviors related to command execution, directory scanning, fetching, and binary checks, as well as a function to replace parts of a module with mocks during testing.
